fields.label: Pinned Version
fields.description: The exact version this user runs. Upgrades are opt-in: nothing moves this field except the user accepting an offer. The one exception is not an exception to THIS field — a blocked version stops the bot and leaves the pin alone, so it is visible in the post-mortem.

fields.label: Risk Profile
fields.description: Empty is legal and safe: an absent profile resolves to the most conservative parameters (rforex.risk_presets.resolve_stored), never to unrestricted.

fields.label: Active
fields.description: The user's own run/pause switch. Turning it on is not sufficient to run — entitlement and the pinned version's status are both checked first, and a blocked version overrides this flag entirely.

fields.label: Last Serving Verdict
fields.description: The last answer rforex.strategy_spec.assignment_verdict gave for this row, recorded so a user asking 'why did my bot stop' gets an answer rather than a shrug.
